messages.subject: Problem with lm.fit
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am new with the pbdR packages. I tried to run some examples with lm.fit using ddmatrix. It worked fine with the following code:

init.grid()

m=5
n=3

x <- ddmatrix("rnorm", nrow = m, ncol = n)
y <- ddmatrix("rnorm", nrow = m, ncol = 1)
model <- lm.fit(x,y)

finalize()

The difference between lm and lm.fit is lm also gives the intercept term when the model is fitted which is not the case with lm.fit. To get the intercept term in lm.fit(), one needs to append one column with 1's. So, when I run the following code in my laptop it again works fine and gives me the desired output.

##personal dataset

y (read from a file)
Mat(read from a file)
x <- cbind(1,Mat[1,])
fit <- lm.fit(x,y)

Now, when I try the following code:

x_temp <- cbind(1,Mat[1,])
x <- as.ddmatrix(x_temp)
fit <- lm.fit(x,y)

I get an error, saying:

Error in lm.fit(x,y) :  INTEGER() can only be applied to a 'integer', not a 'double'

Is there anyone else (or the developers) who has dealt with a similar problem earlier ? Can you please let me know what is going wrong ?
Any kind of help is highly appreciated.

Regards,
Rudradev
